data.name: TemplateHasErrors
data.value: The audit template has errors:
data.comment: First line of the message listing the errors of an audit template (WP-26), one per line below

data.name: ErrorInLine
data.comment: {0}: line number in the template; {1}: error message

data.name: UnknownDirective
data.value: Unknown directive @{0}.

data.name: DirectiveRepeated
data.value: @{0} appears more than once.

data.name: DirectiveMissing
data.value: @{0} is missing.

data.name: DirectiveNeedsValue
data.value: @{0} needs a value.

data.name: DirectiveTakesNoValue
data.value: @{0} takes no value.

data.name: BaseColumnsMode
data.value: @base-columns takes “as-base” or “nullable”.

data.name: TextOutsideSection
data.value: This line belongs to no section: columns stand after @columns, the trigger after @trigger-source.

data.name: TriggerSourceEmpty
data.value: @trigger-source is empty.

data.name: ColumnNameMissing
data.value: A column line starts with the column name.

data.name: ColumnTypeMissing
data.value: {0}: the type is missing.

data.name: ColumnTypeUnknown
data.value: {0}: unknown type “{1}”.
data.comment: {0}: column name; {1}: the type as written in the template

data.name: ColumnNotUnderstood
data.value: {0}: “{1}” not understood. After the type come [GENERATED … AS IDENTITY | DEFAULT …] [NOT NULL | NULL] [-- comment].
data.comment: {0}: column name; {1}: the rest of the line that was not understood

data.name: ColumnDefaultInvalid
data.value: {0}: the default is missing or cannot stand in a statement (no “;”, no bind variable, matching brackets).

data.name: ColumnRepeated
data.value: Column {0} appears more than once.

data.name: NameEmpty
data.value: @{0} gives an empty name.

data.name: PlaceholderUnknown
data.value: Unknown placeholder {0}. Literal braces are written {{{{ and }}}}.

data.name: PlaceholderNotInDirective
data.value: {0} is not available in @{1}.

data.name: PlaceholderOutsideLoop
data.value: {0} only works inside a column loop ({1} … {2}).

data.name: PlaceholderTakesNoOptions
data.value: {0} takes no options.

data.name: LoopOptionUnknown
data.value: Unknown option “{0}”: a column loop takes comparable or incomparable, and sep="…".

data.name: LoopOptionRepeated
data.value: The option {0} appears more than once.

data.name: SeparatorEscape
data.value: Unknown escape “\{0}” in sep: use \n, \t, \" or \\.

data.name: SeparatorNotClosed
data.value: The quotes of sep="…" are not closed on this line.

data.name: LoopNested
data.value: Column loops do not nest: {0} is missing before this {1}.

data.name: LoopUnpaired
data.value: {0} without {1}.
data.comment: {0}, {1}: {each} and {end}, or the other way round

data.name: BraceNotClosed
data.value: “{{” without “}}” on this line. A literal brace is written {{{{.

data.name: BraceNotOpened
data.value: “}}” without “{{”. A literal brace is written }}}}.

data.name: AuditTableIsBaseTable
data.value: The audit table would be table {0} itself.

data.name: ColumnClash
data.value: {0} is a column of the template and of table {1}.

data.name: LongLeftOut
data.value: {0} ({1}) is left out of the audit table and the trigger: a trigger has no :new/:old for LONG.
data.comment: {0}: column name; {1}: LONG or LONG RAW

data.name: NotComparable
data.value: The column loop with comparable in line {0} leaves out {1}: they cannot be compared with <>.
data.comment: {0}: line number in the template; {1}: column names, comma-separated

data.name: LoopEmpty
data.value: The column loop in line {0} has no columns.

data.name: PlanColumnGoneNullable
data.value: {0} is no longer in the table: it stays in {1} with its history and becomes nullable (the trigger no longer fills it).

data.name: PlanNewColumnNullable
data.value: {0} is added to {1} as nullable: the audit table may already have rows without a value.

data.name: PlanTypeIncompatible
data.value: {0} in {1} ({2}) cannot take the values of the table ({3}): the trigger would make every DML on the table fail. Change the audit column by hand first (e.g. a new column), or leave the audit box off.
data.comment: {0}: column name, {1}: audit table name, {2}: type in the audit table, {3}: type in the table, e.g. VARCHAR2(30)

data.name: PlanTypeIncompatibleTemplate
data.value: {0} in {1} ({2}) cannot take the values of the template ({3}): the trigger would make every DML on the table fail. Change the audit column by hand first (e.g. a new column), or leave the audit box off.
data.comment: WP-51. {0}: column name, {1}: audit table name, {2}: type in the audit table, {3}: type in the template

data.name: PlanTypeLossy
data.value: {0} in {1} ({2}) takes the values of the table ({3}) only with a loss (fractional seconds, time zone). The audit column stays as it is; to keep them whole, widen it by hand.
data.comment: WP-51. {0}: column name, {1}: audit table name, {2}: type in the audit table, {3}: type in the table

data.name: PlanTypeLossyTemplate
data.value: {0} in {1} ({2}) takes the values of the template ({3}) only with a loss (fractional seconds, time zone). The audit column stays as it is; to keep them whole, widen it by hand.
data.comment: WP-51. {0}: column name, {1}: audit table name, {2}: type in the audit table, {3}: type in the template

data.name: PlanWiderThanTemplate
data.value: {0} in {1} ({2}) is wider than in the template ({3}): the audit table probably comes from another template. The column stays, but the new trigger only writes values of the template's type – check that this is the right template for this connection.
data.comment: WP-51. {0}: column name, {1}: audit table name, {2}: type in the audit table, {3}: type in the template

data.name: PlanTriggerOnOtherTable
data.value: There is a trigger {0} already, on {1} – choose another trigger name in the template.
data.comment: {0}: trigger name, {1}: owner.table the trigger is on

data.name: PlanTriggerDisabled
data.value: The trigger {0} is up to date but disabled: changes are not audited.

data.name: PlanTriggerEnabled
data.value: The trigger {0} is disabled; rewritten, it is enabled again once it compiles.

data.name: LoopFilterTwice
data.value: A column loop takes either comparable or incomparable.

data.name: TemplateFileMissing
data.value: The audit template {0} does not exist.

data.name: TemplateFileUnreadable
data.value: The audit template {0} cannot be read: {1}
data.comment: {0}: file path, {1}: error message of the file system
